name: postgres_latest_volume_path
title: postgres:latest (18) refuses the /var/lib/postgresql/data volume mount

found_by.how: Team guide setup fix, applied before the reference run. Reproduced afterwards in a throwaway container with a throwaway volume.

command: docker run -d -e POSTGRES_USER=mlflow -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=mlflow -e POSTGRES_DB=mlflow -v fault3-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:latest
error_signature: there appears to be PostgreSQL data in:
error_tail: Error: in 18+, these Docker images are configured to store database data in a
format which is compatible with "pg_ctlcluster" (specifically, using
major-version-specific directory names).  This better reflects how
PostgreSQL itself works, and how upgrades are to be performed.
Counter to that, there appears to be PostgreSQL data in:
This is usually the result of upgrading the Docker image without
upgrading the underlying database using "pg_upgrade" (which requires both
The suggested container configuration for 18+ is to place a single mount
at /var/lib/postgresql which will then place PostgreSQL data in a
subdirectory, allowing usage of "pg_upgrade --link" without mount point

cause.summary: postgres:latest moved to PostgreSQL 18, which expects the volume at /var/lib/postgresql
details: docker-compose.yaml lines 309, 359 and 394 use image: postgres:latest, with volumes mounted at /var/lib/postgresql/data (lines 315, 365, 400).
postgres:latest resolved to PG_MAJOR=18; from 18 on the image keeps data in a version-specific subdirectory and exits 1 when a mount sits at /var/lib/postgresql/data.
postgresmlflow is one of them, so the MLflow server never starts.

fix.action: Replace postgres:latest with postgres:16 (keeps the /var/lib/postgresql/data layout). Moving to 18 would also need the mount moved to /var/lib/postgresql.

static_check.rule: image tag is floating (latest, stable, or missing) instead of an explicit version; for postgres >= 18 also: volume mounted at /var/lib/postgresql/data

reproduce.how: Start postgres:latest with a volume at /var/lib/postgresql/data; it exits 1.
reproduce.note: Depends on what :latest points to; on 2026-10-08 it was PostgreSQL 18.
